mechanism: Amphetamine stimulates sympathomimetic activity which may antagonize the anti-inflammatory effects of budesonide and increase cardiovascular stress; budesonide may also increase amphetamine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and asthma/COPD control closely; consider alternative ADHD therapy if budesonide efficacy is compromised or cardiovascular effects emerge.
